description: Replacement of single storey rear glazing and roof light, replacement of timber cladding on first floor terrace and boundary wall with Vertical cedar cladding, replacement of timber gate on boundary wall with anthracite grey roller shutter and erection of timber bicycle storage area in rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (EX-P-001, EX-P-100, EX-P-101, EX-P-102, EX-E-01, EX-E-02, EX-S-01, EX-G&T-01, Flood Risk Assessment, Design & Access Statement, Received: 4 June 2020 PR-P-100, PR-P-101, PR-P-102, PR-E-01, PR-E-02, PR-S-01, PR-G-01, PR-T-01 Received: 13 July 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  Side walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at 55 Grove Park Gardens London Chiswick W4 3RY. For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
